response.text: A common‑platform firm may be exempt from SYSC 6.1.3‑CR (4) and (5) where it can demonstrate that, given the nature, scale and complexity of its business and the range of its designated investment business, the requirements are not proportionate and its compliance function remains effective [1]. In that circumstance the firm must continually assess whether the effectiveness of the compliance function is being compromised and must review that assessment on a regular basis [1].
